title: scabiosa columbaria var. vera
intro: Scabiosa columbaria var. vera, commonly known as the small scabious, is a flowering plant species in the honeysuckle family (Caprifoliaceae). It is a perennial herb that has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Scabiosa columbaria var. vera include its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in wound healing and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic acids.
